acts.label: bound/G's assent to Y for A, under D

answers.says: 8586137f903c is an update of e7d75677af4a: the update condition answers valid, and it is in force by its own `in_force` (G4.8)

case.name: a delegation ended by the delegator alone: a version that removes the power, with the delegator's part alone, is valid by default
case.sentence: By default the delegator can end it at any time: where those Terms name no update condition, a version of them that removes or narrows the power is valid, and replaces them (G4.8, G4.11(e)), when it carries the delegator's part alone, without the agent's.

reading: the sheet, section 4.3: "G 58 (`update`; 5.5.5, part 1): a delegation ended by the delegator alone, valid by default: G5.5 is gone (its bytes would answer **not shown**)"

draft 26 has no rule letting the delegator alone end a delegation by default: by 5.6.6(a) and 5.5.7(e) such a version needs every known party, the agent among them; the case's sentence (draft 25's G5.5) is gone, and its bytes, read under draft 26, would answer not shown (the sheet's new line 51 tells that story)
the ledger, "Who signs an update by default: the known parties" (26 November, 17:51–17:56)
says: draft 26, 5.6.6(a): "By a version of the Terms that give the power, which ends or narrows it, made as any update of those Terms is: their update condition decides, as its cMIP dictates (5.5.7), or, where they name none, the default (5.5.5(a))"
draft 26, 5.5.7(e): "There is no power for replacement (§5.6): Terms that name no update condition are updated only by their known parties, whatever their `powers` say."

answers.says: in force: the assents its `in_force` rule requires (or, by default, one in the name of every party named as a signer) are present, and no Terms replace them

case.name: no place named: in force per the anchoring the reader accepts, with it named
case.sentence: Where no place is named, a verifier MUST qualify every such answer **as shown**, or **per anchoring** where the reader accepts one, with it named (G13.4).

reading: the lead's note of 27 November, row C9: "Retired; its sentence is gone." The lead's reading, resting on the ledger's "A condition in time with no anchor is refused" (26 November, 18:00–18:30)
says: draft 26, 5.5.3: "A keeper or an anchoring of the reader's own choosing gives an answer only as that reader's, named so: it never gives the Terms' own answer, never puts Terms in force, and never makes an update late (§5.13)."
